description: This file defines the OrderItem entity class for a Spring Boot application, representing individual products within an order in an online shopping system. It includes annotations for JPA ORM mapping, validation constraints, and Lombok for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: Entity class representing an item within an order, including references to the order and product, quantity, price, and subtotal.
